author: Dale College Communications
title: Interact Society Leads Community Outreach Initiative
excerpt: The Dale College Interact Society visited a local children's home, donating essential supplies while mentoring young learners through educational and sporting activities.
content: Members of the Dale College Interact Society spent the afternoon at a local children's home, donating stationery, toiletries and non-perishable food collected through a school-wide drive. Learners also spent time mentoring younger children through educational games and sporting activities, reinforcing the school's commitment to servant leadership and community engagement.

author: Dale College Communications
title: Debating Society Inspires Future Speakers
excerpt: Dale College debaters introduced primary school learners to public speaking through interactive workshops and friendly debates.
content: Representatives from the Dale College Debating Society visited several local primary schools to introduce learners to public speaking and debating. Through interactive workshops and friendly debates, the team encouraged confidence, critical thinking and effective communication among aspiring young speakers.

author: Dale College Communications
title: High Jumper Reaches New Heights at Border Athletics Meeting
excerpt: A personal best performance earned Dale College high jumper Ethan Daniels gold and qualification for the provincial championships.
content: Dale College celebrated an outstanding performance at the Border Athletics Meeting as Grade 11 learner Ethan Daniels claimed gold in the high jump. His personal best clearance secured qualification for the provincial championships and highlighted the strength of the school's athletics programme.

author: Dale College Communications
title: Interhouse Hockey Brings Out Competitive Spirit
excerpt: The annual Interhouse Hockey Festival showcased spirited competition, sportsmanship and house pride across every grade.
content: The annual Interhouse Hockey Festival transformed the Astro into a sea of colour as houses competed for top honours. The day featured spirited competition, outstanding sportsmanship and enthusiastic support from learners, staff and parents, making it one of the highlights of the sporting calendar.

author: Dale College Communications
title: Old Daleians Invest in Future Sporting Facilities
excerpt: The Old Boys Association contributed towards improving Dale College's sporting facilities for future generations of Daleians.
content: The Old Boys Association donated funds towards ongoing improvements to the school's sporting facilities. The contribution will assist with field maintenance, infrastructure upgrades and the continued development of sporting opportunities for current and future Daleians.

author: Dale College Communications
title: Flower Day Celebrates Brotherhood and School Spirit
excerpt: Learners proudly wore flowers on their blazers as part of a cherished Dale tradition supporting community charitable initiatives.
content: Learners proudly wore flowers on their blazers as part of Dale College's annual Flower Day celebration. The tradition encouraged school spirit while raising awareness and support for community charitable initiatives, with every flower worn representing a meaningful contribution.

author: Dale College Communications
title: First XI Complete Unbeaten Weekend at Invitational Festival
excerpt: The Dale College First XI returned unbeaten after an impressive showing at the Eastern Cape Invitational Cricket Festival.
content: The Dale College First XI returned unbeaten from the annual Eastern Cape Invitational Cricket Festival after recording three impressive victories against strong opposition. Disciplined bowling performances, consistent batting partnerships and outstanding fielding ensured the team maintained its excellent form throughout the tournament.

author: Dale College Communications
title: Provincial Colours Awarded to Dale Water Polo Star
excerpt: Grade 12 learner Matthew Jacobs earned Border provincial colours following an outstanding water polo season.
content: Grade 12 learner Matthew Jacobs has been selected to represent the Border provincial water polo team following an exceptional season. His selection recognises years of dedication in the pool and serves as inspiration for younger players within the programme.

author: Dale College Communications
title: Senior Water Polo Squad Impresses at Coastal Tournament
excerpt: The senior water polo side produced determined performances against top schools at the Coastal Invitational Tournament.
content: Competing against some of the country's leading schools, the Dale College senior water polo team produced several determined performances during the Coastal Invitational Tournament. Valuable experience gained over the weekend will strengthen preparations for the remainder of the season.

author: Dale College Communications
title: Hockey Fun Day Unites Junior and Senior Players
excerpt: Learners from every age group came together for a day of hockey, coaching clinics and mixed-team matches celebrating the sport.
content: Learners from every age group enjoyed a relaxed Hockey Fun Day filled with mixed-team matches, skills challenges and coaching clinics. The event promoted friendship across grades while celebrating participation and enjoyment of the sport.

author: Dale College Communications
title: Senior Cricket Side Clinches Derby Victory
excerpt: A disciplined bowling display and composed batting performance secured another memorable derby victory for the First XI.
content: Dale College's First XI secured an emphatic victory over their long-standing rivals after a disciplined bowling display restricted the opposition before a composed batting performance guided the team to victory. The result continues a strong season for the senior cricket programme.

author: Dale College Communications
title: Choir Earns National Recognition with Fourth-Place Finish
excerpt: Dale College's choir finished fourth nationally after impressing judges with its distinctive blend of gwijo-inspired harmonies and classical choral excellence.
content: The Dale College Choir delivered an unforgettable performance at the National Schools Choir Competition, finishing fourth overall. Judges praised the choir's unique programme, which blended powerful gwijo-inspired harmonies with refined classical choral technique, earning standing ovations and widespread admiration from audiences and fellow competitors alike.
